name: Synapse
param_style: ? positional (Python sqlite3 DB-API); IN lists, pagination bounds and event filters spliced in at runtime
schema_source: synapse/storage/schema/{main,state}/full_schemas/72/full.sql.sqlite + main/delta/73..95 *.sql/*.sql.sqlite applied, needed tables dumped; background-update indexes added by hand (AGPL: CREATE statements only)
data_scale: scale 1: 2000 users, 300 rooms (20 big), ~10k memberships, ~42k events (30k timeline), ~5k relations, ~50k push actions, ~19k receipts, 25k FTS4 rows, 4.5k state groups
visibility_note: The reference Matrix homeserver; SQLite is officially supported for small deployments and is the default in the demo/test configs
interest_note: Notification badge counts (receipt CTE joined twice, scalar MAX of COALESCEs), sync/sliding-sync membership deltas (UNION ALL derived tables, 4-5 LEFT JOINs), recursive relation walks, FTS4 search with CROSS JOIN, room directory UNION + LIKE.
reach_note: reference Matrix homeserver (matrix.org); SQLite supported for small deployments
